csv_scope_of_work: The mission of Empire State Development (ESD) is to promote a vigorous and growing state economy, encourage business investment and job creation, and support local economies across New York State. The primary objective of this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is to establish a Prequalified Pool (or "retainer list") of expert vendors across seven distinct service lots. SCOPE OF WORK : Economic Analysis, Research & Strategic Planning, Site Selection & Competitive Benchmarking, Industrial Site Development & Design, Learning Platform Strategy & Technical Assistance, Events, Marketing & Stakeholder Engagement, Corporate Sustainability & Advanced Manufacturing Solutions, Industrial Site Readiness & Permitting
csv_disciplines_requested: Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Site Evaluation/Selection, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Analytical/Testing Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design

title: Consultant for Economic Development Services
short_description: Prequalification pool for economic development, planning, site readiness, and related advisory services.
project_scope: Establishment of a prequalified pool of vendors across seven service lots for Empire State Development. Scope includes economic analysis, research and strategic planning, site selection and competitive benchmarking, industrial site development and design, learning platform strategy and technical assistance, events, marketing and stakeholder engagement, corporate sustainability and advanced manufacturing solutions, and industrial site readiness and permitting. Requested disciplines include surveying/GIS/mapping, site evaluation/selection, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, analytical/testing services, and environmental engineering/planning/design.
services: Prequalification/RFQ for advisory and planning services, including strategic planning, site selection, industrial site development and design, permitting support, surveying/GIS/mapping, redevelopment planning, and environmental planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style prequalified pool rather than a defined project.
- Focus is economic development, planning, benchmarking, marketing, and advisory services.
- No specific bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structural engineering scope identified.
- Requested disciplines align more with planning, environmental, and consulting services than sbp core structural design work.
- Falls under framework agreements without technical specification, which are not of interest.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for a prequalified consultant pool and not for a specific construction project. No realistic project-specific construction cost estimate is possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is a prequalification pool for broad consulting services without a defined structural engineering scope, no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Vendors are to be prequalified as expert providers across seven service lots. Specific reference counts or structural qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text. Participation goals: MBE 15%, WBE 15%, SDVOB 6%.
award_criteria: Not stated in the provided text. The notice is an RFQ to establish a prequalified pool.
